lines.japanese:
学校帰り、忍は悲鳴を聞いた。
　切迫した悲鳴。
lines.english: On his way home from school, Shinobu heard a scream. An urgent scream.

lines.japanese:
場所が草原だったことが、忍の興味を引いた。
　場合によっては報告すべき出来事だと判断したか
らだ。
lines.english: The location—a meadow—caught Shinobu’s attention. Depending on the circumstances, he judged, it might be something he ought to report.

lines.japanese:
慎重に、様子を見に行く。
　気取られぬよう、朽ちた古木に身を重ねた。
lines.english: He went to investigate, moving cautiously. Keeping himself hidden, he pressed against the trunk of a rotting old tree.

lines.japanese:
六人の少年が、一人を押さえつけている。
　衣服を脱がすことで、屈辱を与えようとしている
ようだ。
lines.english: Six boys had pinned one child down. They appeared to be trying to humiliate the victim by stripping the child's clothes off.

lines.japanese:
忍は微動だにせず、静観を続けた。
　加害者側が興奮状態にあることはすぐにわかった。
lines.english: Shinobu remained perfectly still and continued to observe. He recognized at once that the aggressors were in a state of excitement.

lines.japanese:
適合しきれなかったＵＳＥＲが、性格的な破綻を
きたし、嗜好や性行を肥大化させる様に似ていた。
lines.english: It resembled an incompletely acclimated USER whose personality was breaking down, its tastes and behavior grotesquely exaggerated.

lines.japanese:
そんなものを、貴宮忍は見続けてきたのだ。
　目前の光景が健全な虐待行為としか見えないのも、
当然だろう。
lines.english: Shinobu Atemiya had seen such things time and again. Little wonder the scene before him looked like nothing more than a wholesome act of abuse.

lines.japanese: 「やめろ！　やめ―――ッッッ！」
lines.english: “Stop! Sto—aaagh!”

lines.japanese:
必死に暴れる少女は……あずさだ。
　手足を押さえつけられ、口を塞がれ、全身をまさ
ぐられる。
lines.english: The girl struggling desperately was… Azusa. They pinned her limbs, covered her mouth, and pawed at her entire body.

lines.japanese: 「んーーーーーーーーーーッッッ！！」
lines.english: “Mmmmmmmmmph!!”

lines.japanese: 「いてっ！」
lines.english: “Ow!”

lines.japanese: 「こいつ噛みやがったっ！　ざけんなっ！」
lines.english: “The little shit bit me! Screw you!”

lines.japanese:
平手の音。
　合計四度。
lines.english: The sound of a slap. Four in all.

lines.japanese: 「う、ううう……」
lines.english: “Uh… uhhh…”

lines.japanese: 抵抗する力を失う。
lines.english: The strength to resist left her.

lines.japanese: 「今のうちに脱がせ！」
lines.english: “Get those clothes off—now!”

lines.japanese: 衣類が引きはがされていく。
lines.english: They tore away her clothes.

lines.japanese: 「見ろよ、ついてねー！」
lines.english: “Look! There's nothing there!”

lines.japanese: あずさは裸に剥かれ、宙吊りにされる。
lines.english: They stripped Azusa naked and hoisted her into the air.

lines.japanese: 「いやぁぁぁぁぁーっ！？」
lines.english: “Nooooooooo!”

lines.japanese:
耳をつんざく、
　悲鳴―――
lines.english: An ear-splitting scream—

lines.japanese:
忍は何も感じなかった。
　ただ、あずさが少女であるという事実を、知った
だけだ。
lines.english: Shinobu felt nothing. He had merely learned the fact that Azusa was a girl, nothing more.

lines.japanese:
少年だと思っていた被害者についての情報を修正
した。
lines.english: He amended his information on the victim, whom he had taken for a boy.

lines.japanese:
そして、このレベルなら放置しておいてもいいと
考えた。
lines.english: He then determined that an incident of this level could be left alone.

lines.japanese:
行為はまだ続いていたし、さらにエスカレートし
ていくことが予測されたが、忍に介入するつもりは
なかった。
lines.english: The assault was still in progress and could be expected to escalate further, but Shinobu had no intention of intervening.

lines.japanese:
紅緒あずさは、事前に報告されていたナチュラル・
ユーザーではない。
lines.english: Azusa Benio was not one of the Natural Users named in the prior report.

lines.japanese:
監視対象外。
　施設のそばでの行為ではあるが、警戒レベルを一段
階下げることにした。
lines.english: She was not under surveillance. Though the incident was occurring near the facility, he lowered the alert level by one stage.

lines.japanese:
逆さ吊りにされたあずさの目線が、偶然忍を視界に
おさめた。
lines.english: Hanging upside down, Azusa happened to catch sight of Shinobu.

lines.japanese: 発見された。
lines.english: He had been discovered.

lines.japanese:
少しだけ動揺したが、民事であることを思い返し、
すぐに冷静さを取り戻す。
lines.english: He was briefly unsettled, but remembered that this was a civil matter and immediately regained his composure.

lines.japanese:
問題は彼女が、周囲の少年たちにそのことを告げ
た時だ。
lines.english: The difficulty would arise if she alerted the boys around her to his presence.

lines.japanese:
多少、厄介なことになる。
　判断は迅速に。
lines.english: That would create a minor complication. A decision must be made quickly.

lines.japanese:
忍は現場から離れることを決めた。
　一歩下がる。
lines.english: Shinobu decided to withdraw from the scene. He took one step back.

lines.japanese: 枯れ木を踏んだ。
lines.english: A dead branch snapped underfoot.

lines.japanese:
場のどんな声や物音より、小さな音だった。
　だが異質な音だった。
lines.english: It was quieter than any voice or noise already present. But it was out of place.

lines.japanese:
事実、少年たちは一斉に停止した。
　場のうねりが、自分に向かって収束していくのを
忍は感じた。
lines.english: Sure enough, the boys all froze at once. Shinobu felt the turbulence in the field converge upon him.

lines.japanese:
極めて低位階の現象ではあるが、発症前の一般人
であっても、集団意志によって模倣子の分布に影響
を与えることがある。
lines.english: Though an extremely low-order phenomenon, even ordinary people who have yet to manifest can, through collective will, affect the distribution of mimetic units.

hyperlinks.preview: A concept proposed by biologist Richard Dawkins in his book “The Selfish Gene.” Also translated as “

lines.japanese: 忍が察知したのは、そういった流れだ。
lines.english: That was the current Shinobu had detected.

lines.japanese: 「おい、誰か見てこいよ」
lines.english: “Hey. Somebody go look.”

lines.japanese:
二人ほどが頷き、近づいてくる。
　忍は慌てず対策を練った。
　一秒。
lines.english: Two of them nodded and began to approach. Shinobu calmly devised a response. One second.

lines.japanese:
必要にして充分な時間だ。
　どこかの国から流れてきたものを、誰かがたわむ
れに訳したもの。
lines.english: All the time he needed. A document that had drifted in from some foreign country, then been translated on someone's whim.

lines.japanese:
諜報活動の教本。
　複製されて、非公式ではあるが現場レベルで用い
られている。
lines.english: A manual for intelligence operations. Copies circulated unofficially, but the manual saw practical use in the field.

lines.japanese:
加害行為中の民間人への対処の項目があったはず
だ。
lines.english: It had contained a section on handling civilians engaged in acts of aggression.

lines.japanese:
閉鎖空間か、または人里離れた場所以外では、行
為をピックアップさせようとすることで、場を沈静
化することができる。
lines.english: Outside an enclosed space or an isolated location, drawing attention to what was happening could defuse the situation.

lines.japanese:
心理誘導技術。
　具体的には、継続的な大音量か、司法的措置を予
想させる発言を―――
lines.english: A technique of psychological manipulation. Specifically: sustained loud noise, or a statement that would lead the subjects to anticipate legal intervention—

lines.japanese:
忍は息を吸った。
　足下の枯れ木を、意図的に強く踏みにじる。
lines.english: Shinobu drew breath. He deliberately ground his foot down hard on the dead branch.

lines.japanese: そして叫ぶ。
lines.english: Then he shouted.

lines.japanese: 「先生、こっちです！」
lines.english: “Teacher! Over here!”

lines.japanese:
少年たちは停止し、逃げ出した。
　全裸に近いあずさが残された。
lines.english: The boys froze, then fled. Azusa was left behind, nearly naked.

lines.japanese:
放置するべきか、否か。
　活動に影響がないのはどちらか？
　熟考した。
lines.english: Should he leave her there or not? Which option would have no impact on his activities? He considered the matter carefully.

lines.japanese:
放置して立ち去ることも考えたが、不自然かも知
れない。
lines.english: Leaving her and walking away was one possibility, but that might appear unnatural.

lines.japanese: この場合、普通は―――
lines.english: Under these circumstances, an ordinary person would—

lines.japanese: 「大丈夫？」
lines.english: “Are you all right?”

lines.japanese:
感情のない気遣いを、あずさも察したのかも知れ
ない。
lines.english: Perhaps Azusa sensed that his concern was devoid of feeling.

lines.japanese: 無視している。
lines.english: She ignored him.

lines.japanese:
忍は残されたシャツを拾い、手渡した。
　奪うように受け取り、あずさは忍を睨む。
lines.english: Shinobu picked up the shirt they had left and held it out to her. Azusa snatched it from him and glared.

lines.japanese:
興奮した相手と直接目を合わせては行けない。
　視線を受け止めることで、相手は挑発されたと感
じ、一方的に激昂するケースが多いからだ。
lines.english: One must not make direct eye contact with an agitated subject. Meeting the subject's gaze is often perceived as a provocation, and they may fly into a rage on that basis alone.

lines.japanese:
目をそらすのが最善。怯えすぎても逆効果。
　周囲に大衆がいれば完全にまぎれることができ……
怒りは個別の対象を失う。
lines.english: Looking away is optimal. Excessive fear is likewise counterproductive. If a crowd is present, one can disappear into it entirely… and the anger loses its individual target.

lines.japanese: 「なんだよ！」
lines.english: “What?!”

lines.japanese:
「なに黙ってんだよ！
　なにか言いたいことがあんだろ！」
lines.english: “Why won’t you say anything?! You’ve got something to say, don’t you?”

lines.japanese:
「いじめがそんなに珍しいのかよ！
　それとも、おまえもいじめたいのか！」
lines.english: “Never seen somebody get picked on before?! Or do you want a turn too?”

lines.japanese:
「やりたきゃやれよ！
　あいつらの仲間になりたかったらやれよ！」
lines.english: “Then go on! Do it! If you want to be one of them, go on and do it!”

lines.japanese:
当事者は忍ではない。
　忍は救済者である。
lines.english: Shinobu was not a party to the incident. Shinobu was her rescuer.

lines.japanese:
あずさもそれをよく知っているから、叫ぶ内容は
適正なものではない。
lines.english: Azusa knew that perfectly well, too, so her accusations were misplaced.

lines.japanese:
個別の対象を失い、怒りが拡散していく。
　濃度を失い、対象を有さない悲しみの感情が、支
配的になる。
lines.english: With no individual target, her anger began to disperse. It lost its concentration, and sorrow without an object became the dominant emotion.

lines.japanese: 怒声はすぐに途切れた。
lines.english: Her shouting quickly died away.

lines.japanese: 「なんだよ……おまえ……」
lines.english: “What… are you?”

lines.japanese: ようやく忍は、目線をあずさに戻した。
lines.english: Only then did Shinobu look back at Azusa.

lines.japanese: 「……うっ、うくっ……んっ……」
lines.english: “…Hh… ngh… mm…”

lines.japanese: 体育用のジャージを出してあずさに渡す。
lines.english: He took out his school tracksuit and held it out to Azusa.

lines.japanese: 「……ほっといてよ」
lines.english: “…Leave me alone.”

lines.japanese: 受け取らない。
lines.english: She would not take it.

lines.japanese: 「いいから、かまわないで」
lines.english: “I said leave me alone.”

lines.japanese:
ジャージを、あずさの横に無造作に置いた。
　このまま無言で帰るのも不自然と思ったのか、
lines.english: He dropped the tracksuit carelessly beside Azusa. Perhaps he judged that leaving in silence would also seem unnatural—

lines.japanese: 「……もっとうまくやらないとダメだ」
lines.english: “…You have to handle it better than this.”

lines.japanese: あずさに火をつけた。
lines.english: That set Azusa off.

lines.japanese: 「うるせーよ！　関係ないってんだろぉ！」
lines.english: “Shut up! I told you it's none of your business!”

lines.japanese:
「行けよ！　行けよバカ、いつおまえなんかに助け
　てくれって頼んだよ！　おまえなんてしらねーし、
　なんの、なんのっ―――」
lines.english: “Go away! Go away, idiot! When did I ever ask somebody like you to help me? I don't even know you! You're—you're just— just—”

lines.japanese:
あとはもう言葉にならない。
　泣き声はもらさない。
　決壊はしない。
lines.english: After that, the words would no longer come. She would not let herself cry aloud. She would not break.

lines.japanese:
ただ嗚咽だけを、幾度も幾度も呑み込んでいた。
　暴風雨のような屈辱を、胎内に押さえ込もうとす
るかのように。
lines.english: She only swallowed one sob after another, again and again. As though trying to cage a storm of humiliation inside her own body.

lines.japanese: 解決―――
lines.english: Resolved—

lines.japanese:
忍はきびすを返し、立ち去った。
　何を感じることもなく。
lines.english: Shinobu turned on his heel and left. Without feeling a thing.
